# Scaleway — Scaleway Startup Program

Three stage-based cloud credit tiers: up to EUR 1,000 over one year (Founders), EUR 9,000 over six months (Early Stage), and EUR 36,000 over twelve months (Growth Stage).

|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |

| **Category** | [☁️ Cloud](../categories/cloud.md) |

| | |

| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | €36,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Page states the credit window runs 6 or 12 months after credits activation, depending on stage. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Founders Program | €1,000 | up to €1,000 cloud credits to use over one year on our multi-cloud products | _Not stated by the vendor_ |
| Early Stage Program | €9,000 | 1 500€ per month for 6 month, for a total of 9,000€ in cloud credits | _Not stated by the vendor_ |
| Growth Stage Program | €36,000 | 3000€ per month for 12 month, for a total of 36,000€ in cloud credits | _Not stated by the vendor_ |

### Not covered

- Existing Scaleway clients
